mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM without subsequent tightening by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and can lead to higher inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to raise rates and thus reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE drops below 4% without subsequent Fed rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances following RSAFS increases, or RSAFS increases without corresponding improvements in corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO falls below its 12-month MA without subsequent earnings declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals aggressive inflation fighting by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tighter financial conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described conditions occur without subsequent tightening measures by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a mismatch in labor market dynamics, which can lead to uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described labor market conditions occur without subsequent market uncertainty.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases significantly without corresponding improvements in related sector performance.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) falls below its 6-month moving average, it signals a weakening supply side and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% AND INDPRO < 6-month MA
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described economic conditions occur without subsequent market declines.
